profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Addi
profile.summary: Software Engineer with strong experience in architecting and delivering AI-driven, full-stack, and cloud-native solutions.

positions.title: Software Consultant
positions.insights: AWS Glue, Amazon Web Services (AWS) and +4 skills

positions.title: Systems Developer
positions.description:
Designed and deployed a job-matching ML model in Python, improving candidate matching accuracy and recruiter productivity.

Built an AI-assisted resume and cover letter generator (Blazor, C#, vector database, RAG, LLM) cutting document creation from 15 minutes to under 1 minute.

Created an AI-based resume parser reducing manual data entry time by 90%.

positions.title: Chatbot Developer
positions.description:
Developed and implemented automation solutions, significantly optimizing recruitment processes and enhancing operational efficiency. Improved candidate onboarding and credentialing, leading to streamlined workflows and reduced processing times.

Designed and deployed over 15 advanced chatbots, boosting candidate engagement and satisfaction within the healthcare recruitment sector. Leveraged chatbot capabilities for personalized support, guiding candidates through the recruitment process, and achieving a significant increase in interactions.

Aligned automation initiatives with Acacium Group’s 5-year strategic plan, ensuring all projects contributed to long-term growth. This strategic alignment enhanced market competitiveness and operational success.
